source.meta: Robert C. Martin, The Single Responsibility Principle
source.quote: Gather together the things that change for the same reasons.  Separate those things that change for different reasons.

source.meta: Robert C. Martin, The Clean Architecture
source.quote: Nothing in an inner circle can know anything at all about something in an outer circle.

source.quote: Allow an application to equally be driven by users, programs, automated test or batch scripts, and to be developed and tested in isolation from its eventual run-time devices and databases.
